description_en: Deletes an Express Connect circuit connection
description_zh: 调用DeletePhysicalConnection接口删除物理专线连接
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-119mfjzm7000000000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en:
